preconditions.description: The number of strings n must be between 1 and 30 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(s, str) for s in A)
preconditions.description: All elements in the list A must be strings.
The length of the list A must be equal to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(f(L) for L in sublists))
postconditions.description: The output must be the sum of f(L) for all nonempty contiguous sublists L of A.
